title: Japan develops a method to recover up to 90% of lithium from used EV batteries
summary: Japan has developed an innovative recycling method that can recover up to 90% of lithium from end-of-life electric vehicle batteries, representing a major breakthrough in sustainable battery resource management and reducing dependence on raw material mining.
problem_solved: Addresses the critical challenge of efficiently extracting valuable lithium from discarded EV batteries, which is essential for sustainable electric vehicle adoption and reducing environmental impact.
why_valuable: This technology significantly reduces dependence on lithium mining, lowers EV battery costs, and addresses environmental concerns about battery disposal while creating a circular economy for critical battery materials.
